neighbours.label: the token ' atr' / 'atri' of atrium, atria, atrial
fire: The patient was diagnosed with atrial fibrillation after a long flight.
Blood flows from the left atrium into the left ventricle.
The hotel lobby opens into a bright glass atrium with palm trees.
Both atria contract slightly before the ventricles do.
The doctor noticed an enlarged right atrium on the scan.
Some patients develop atrial flutter, which causes a rapid heartbeat.
The museum's central atrium hosts concerts on weekends.
Older dogs with atrial disease often tire quickly.
quiet: The patient was diagnosed with a heart murmur after a long flight.
Blood flows from the left ventricle into the aorta.
The hotel lobby opens into a bright glass courtyard with palm trees.
Both ventricles contract at the same moment.
The doctor noticed an enlarged right ventricle on the scan.
Some patients develop tachycardia, which causes a rapid heartbeat.
The museum's central hall hosts concerts on weekends.
Older dogs with valve disease often tire quickly.
